common.tagline: Wroshyr-tree homeworld of the Wookiees — and an Imperial slave colony.
common.government: Imperial Occupation Authority over scattered Wookiee elders' councils
common.famousFor: Wookiees. Wroshyr trees a kilometer tall. Imperial slaver garrisons that sailors avoid being asked about.
common.cantinaReputation: Wookiee homeworld. Towering wroshyr trees form a vertical ecosystem kilometers high. In 15 BBY, the Empire occupies Kashyyyk, enslaving Wookiees for labor. Trandoshan slavers operate openly. The Wookiee resistance runs a dangerous underground — sympathetic spacers can find fuel and repairs in hidden tree-city docks, but getting caught means a one-way trip to the spice mines of Kessel.
